question: A new rule, predictions pushed first: the tab a block panel opens on. Seen in CAP-T12PHONERISE.json (two shots): a fresh browser opened a new Newsletter on Content; after Exit Without Saving and Edit again in the same browser, a new Newsletter opened on Design, the tab the last panel had left. Ours opens on Content (Newsletter, Button) every time.
rule: One remembered tab for the browser session, kept through Exit: Edit opens a block panel on the last tab any panel showed, if the block has a tab of that name, else on its first tab. Nothing remembered: the first tab.
how: Probe page, window 1600 by 1000. A new Newsletter, Edit; Design, Escape, select it again, Edit; Escape, a new Button, Edit; Animation, Escape, the Newsletter, Edit; Escape, the Button, Edit. The run twice, the second after Exit Without Saving and Edit again (run 1 ends on Content, so run 2 starts as run 1). Read: which of Form Name (Newsletter Content), Attach link (Button Content), Layout and Blur (Newsletter Design) show, plus a shot.

predictions.button: Design (no Attach link; the shot names the tab)
predictions.nl after animation: Content: a Newsletter has no Animation tab, so its first tab
